title: Generic primary filtration and compatible finite etale cover
statement: With the original curve, normalization-model and finite ell-primary stalk hypotheses of lem-sc-generic-primary-coarse-trace-retraction, there are D, pi, an integral structure, n and F with zero initial sheaf and the same finite constant Z/ell biproduct short-exact successor quotients. In addition there is a finite etale generic morphism q:Spec D.functionField -> Spec C.functionField, commuting with pi and both generic-point morphisms, of constant degree d coprime to ell. A power ell^e annihilates the identity of M, and q^* M is isomorphic to F(n). The statement does not assert a retraction.

proof.text: Use the abelian stalk/Galois-module equivalence and Sylow filtration to obtain an open subgroup H of prime-to-ell index and a full invariant chain with trivial quotients killed by ell.

Take the finite separable fixed field L of H, with degree equal to its index. Transport restriction and the full chain to Spec L; choose finite ZMod ell bases of its trivial quotients. Extend F constantly after n.

Apply hmodel to L and normalize C in L. Use its generic-point isomorphism to transport the chain and terminal identification; define q using its inverse. The normalization diagram gives the commuting square. Finiteness, etaleness, and degree of Spec L -> Spec K are preserved by that isomorphism.

Take a maximum of the ell-power annihilators of the finite stalk elements. Faithfulness of the abelian stalk equivalence gives ell^e times id M equal to zero. The zero stalk admits n=0 and exponent zero.
